name: Red Experience
source:
The protagonist, Sooyeon Hong, wakes up in an unfamiliar place with only hazy memories. There, she is forcibly enlisted into a brutal game by a mysterious mask.

Yet, something feels wrong. There are too many oddities for it to be a simple kidnapping death game. Players must constantly consider which choices will allow Sooyeon to approach the game's hidden reality.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4128940/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
女主角洪秀妍在记忆模糊的状态下于一处陌生的地方醒来，并在一名神秘面具人的胁迫下，被强行卷入了一场残酷的死亡游戏。

然而，一切都透着说不出的违和感。现场存在着太多蹊跷疑点，绝非单纯的绑架杀人游戏所能解释。玩家必须时刻深思熟虑，判断怎样的抉择才能让秀妍一步步逼近潜藏在这场游戏背后的真实面目。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4128940/]Steam[/url]]
